name: ggshield
description: Scan for hardcoded secrets using ggshield. Credentials are read from a Generic service connection.
author: GitGuardian

inputs.name: gitguardianConnection
inputs.label: GitGuardian service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Generic service connection that stores the ggshield API key (Password field) and, optionally, the GitGuardian dashboard URL (Server URL field, e.g. `https://dashboard.gitguardian.com` for SaaS US, `https://dashboard.eu1.gitguardian.com` for SaaS EU, or your self-hosted dashboard URL). ggshield derives the API URL from the dashboard URL.

inputs.name: scanScope
inputs.label: Scan scope
inputs.helpMarkDown:
`changes` scans the commits that triggered this run. 

`repository` scans the checked-out working tree. It honors the repository's `.gitignore`. Use it for a periodic full-repository scan, and keep `changes` on pull request validation.
